sources.snippet: Valeo.ai, Paris; Fundamental AI Lab, UTN; VIS Lab, University of Amsterdam Welcome to the official codebase for Franca (pronounced Fran-ka), the first fully open-source vision foundation model—including data, code, and pretrained weights. Franca matches or surpasses the performance of leading proprietary models such as DINOv2, CLIP, and SigLIPv2.

sources.snippet: Franca, an open-source vision foundation model, achieves high performance using a transparent training pipeline and novel clustering and disentanglement techniques.

sources.title: Franca: Nested Matryoshka Clustering for Scalable Visual Representation ...
sources.snippet: To address this, we introduce a parameter-efficient, multi-head clustering projector based on nested Matryoshka representations. This design progressively refines features into increasingly fine-grained clusters without increasing the model size, enabling both performance and memory efficiency.
